problem.passage:
An art historian is analyzing the value of two paintings acquired by a private gallery. Painting X was purchased in 2000 and its estimated value has increased at a constant rate each year since then. Painting Y was purchased in 2005 at a higher initial price but its estimated value has increased at a different constant rate. The graph shows line $x$, representing the value of Painting X, and line $y$, representing the value of Painting Y, both in thousands of dollars, as functions of the number of years $n$ since 2000.

Based on the graph, in what year do Painting X and Painting Y have the same estimated value?
problem.stimulus: An art historian is analyzing the value of two paintings acquired by a private gallery. Painting X was purchased in 2000 and its estimated value has increased at a constant rate each year since then. Painting Y was purchased in 2005 at a higher initial price but its estimated value has increased at a different constant rate. The graph shows line $x$, representing the value of Painting X, and line $y$, representing the value of Painting Y, both in thousands of dollars, as functions of the number of years $n$ since 2000.
problem.question: Based on the graph, in what year do Painting X and Painting Y have the same estimated value?
problem.explanation: 선 $x$는 $y = 4n + 20$으로, 2000년(즉 $n=0$)에 20(천 달러)에서 시작해 매년 4씩 증가한다. 선 $y$는 $y = 6n - 20$으로, 2005년($n=5$)에 구입되어 그때 값이 $6(5)-20=10$이며 매년 6씩 증가한다(그래프에서 $n=5$부터 시작하는 것으로 표시됨). 두 값이 같아지는 시점은 $4n+20 = 6n-20$을 풀면 된다: $40 = 2n$, 따라서 $n=20$. $n=20$은 2000년으로부터 20년 후이므로 2020년이다. 그래프의 교점 Q도 $n=20$에 위치하므로 일치한다. 따라서 정답은 C번이다.
problem.explanationEn: Line $x$ is $y = 4n + 20$, starting at 20 (thousand dollars) in year 2000 ($n=0$) and increasing by 4 each year. Line $y$ is $y = 6n - 20$, starting at $6(5)-20 = 10$ when purchased in 2005 ($n=5$) and increasing by 6 each year (the graph shows this line beginning at $n=5$). Setting the values equal: $4n+20 = 6n-20$, so $40 = 2n$, giving $n = 20$. Since $n=20$ corresponds to 20 years after 2000, this is the year 2020. This matches intersection point Q on the graph at $n=20$. Therefore, the correct answer is C.

distractorRationales.matches: the year Painting Y was purchased plus a small miscalculated offset
distractorRationales.plausible_because: a student might confuse the purchase year of Painting Y (2005) with the equal-value year and add a rough guess to get 2010
distractorRationales.why_wrong: in 2010 ($n=10$), Painting X is worth $60,000 and Painting Y is worth $40,000, which are not equal

distractorRationales.matches: a sign error when setting up the equation, e.g., $4n+20=6n+20$
distractorRationales.plausible_because: if a student forgets Painting Y's negative intercept and instead treats it as $+20$, they get $n=0$, which after further confusion could be misread as 2015 from the graph
distractorRationales.why_wrong: in 2015 ($n=15$), Painting X is worth $80,000 and Painting Y is worth $70,000, which are not equal

distractorRationales.matches: reading a gridline just past the actual intersection point
distractorRationales.plausible_because: visually estimating from the graph without solving algebraically could lead to overshooting the intersection by one gridline
distractorRationales.why_wrong: in 2025 ($n=25$), Painting X is worth $120,000 and Painting Y is worth $130,000, which are not equal, and this is past the true intersection point Q

difficultyReasons: 연립방정식을 세우고 풀어야 하는 2단계 추론(식 세우기+풀이)
그래프에서 주어진 점 Q(20,100)이 실제 교점임을 인식해야 함
오답들은 근처 연도값으로 계산 오류나 대략적 추정에서 나올 수 있어 변별력 있음
직선의 기울기와 절편을 정확히 해석해야 함

distractors.plausibleBecause: n=10을 대입하면 x=60, y=40으로 값이 가깝다고 느낄 수 있으나 실제로는 같지 않음
distractors.matches: 두 직선의 방정식 형태(4n+20, 6n-20)를 어림으로 계산

distractors.plausibleBecause: 그래프 상 중간 지점으로 보이는 값이라 대략적으로 골랐을 가능성
교점 이후의 값으로, 두 직선이 이미 교차한 후이므로 y값 차이가 다시 벌어지는 시점이라 혼동 가능
distractors.matches: 그래프 상 Q점(20,100) 이후 지점이라 착각할 수 있음
distractors.whyWrong: 4(25)+20=120, 6(25)-20=130으로 이미 y가 x를 앞지른 상태이며 교점이 아님
